spec.title: Latest sensor glucose
spec.description: Latest valid SG, converted from the API integer to mmol/L because the latest pump snapshot reports bgUnits=MMOL_L.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'sg') AS DOUBLE) / 18.0182, 1) AS "Glucose (mmol/L)"
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'sg') AS DOUBLE) > 0
ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) DESC LIMIT 1

spec.title: Current pump status
spec.description: Latest state snapshot: reservoir, batteries, connectivity, automation and reported glucose unit.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  fetched_at AS "Fetched at",
  payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'bgUnits' AS "Reported unit",
  TRY_CAST((payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'reservoirRemainingUnits') AS DOUBLE) AS "Reservoir (U)",
  TRY_CAST((payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'pumpBatteryLevelPercent') AS DOUBLE) AS "Pump battery (%)",
  TRY_CAST((payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'gstBatteryLevel') AS DOUBLE) AS "Transmitter battery (%)",
  payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'lastSGTrend' AS "SG trend",
  payload -> 'patientData' -> 'therapyAlgorithmState' ->> 'autoModeShieldState' AS "Automation state",
  payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'pumpSuspended' AS "Pump suspended",
  payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'conduitInRange' AS "Conduit in range",
  payload -> 'patientData' ->> 'conduitSensorInRange' AS "Sensor in range"
FROM carelink_snapshots
ORDER BY fetched_at DESC
LIMIT 1

spec.title: Sensor glucose trend
spec.description: CGM trace in mmol/L. Guide lines use the common 3.9–10.0 mmol/L reporting range; this is retrospective information, not dosing guidance.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
 ROUND(TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'sg') AS DOUBLE) / 18.0182, 2) AS "SG (mmol/L)",
 3.9 AS "Low guide", 10.0 AS "High guide"
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Glucose summary
spec.description: Aggregation of positive sensor-glucose readings in the selected time range.

spec.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
 SELECT TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE) sg FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)))
SELECT COUNT(*) readings, ROUND(AVG(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "Mean mmol/L",
 ROUND(MEDIAN(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "Median mmol/L", ROUND(MIN(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "Minimum mmol/L",
 ROUND(MAX(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "Maximum mmol/L", ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "SD mmol/L"
FROM x

spec.title: Hourly glucose aggregation
spec.description: Hourly average, minimum and maximum positive sensor-glucose readings.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour',CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) AS time,
 AVG(TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE))/18.0182 AS average,
 MIN(TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE))/18.0182 AS minimum,
 MAX(TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE))/18.0182 AS maximum
FROM carelink_history WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Auto-basal delivery markers
spec.description: AUTO_BASAL_DELIVERY marker field named bolusAmount by the CareLink API. This is displayed without reinterpreting it as a treatment recommendation.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
  TRY_CAST((payload -> 'data' -> 'dataValues' ->> 'bolusAmount') AS DOUBLE) AS delivery
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'markers'
  AND (payload ->> 'type') = 'AUTO_BASAL_DELIVERY'
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Active insulin
spec.description: Active-insulin amount snapshots reported by CareLink.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
  TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'amount') AS DOUBLE) AS active_insulin
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'activeInsulin'
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Pump event counts by type
spec.description: Counts of every CareLink marker type returned in the selected time range.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (payload ->> 'type') AS marker_type,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'markers'
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.title: Pump event log
spec.description: All returned marker events, including their original JSON payload for fields not separately charted.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
  payload ->> 'type' AS event_type,
  payload ->> 'displayTime' AS display_time,
  CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload_json
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'markers'
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 500

spec.title: Cleared notifications and last alarm
spec.description: Notifications and alarm records returned by CareLink; this is a history display, not an alerting system.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
  record_type,
  payload ->> 'type' AS type,
  payload ->> 'faultId' AS fault_id,
  payload ->> 'triggeredDateTime' AS triggered_at,
  CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload_json
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type IN ('notification_clearedNotifications', 'lastAlarm')
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY time DESC

spec.title: Reported limits
spec.description: Limit records returned by CareLink, shown without assuming their clinical meaning or units.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
  TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'lowLimit') AS DOUBLE) AS low_limit,
  TRY_CAST((payload ->> 'highLimit') AS DOUBLE) AS high_limit,
  CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload_json
FROM carelink_history
WHERE record_type = 'limits'
  AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY time DESC

spec.title: Complete CareLink API snapshots
spec.description: Raw complete responses. This panel preserves access to all API fields that are not yet promoted into a dedicated visualization.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  fetched_at,
  source_updated_at_ms,
  device_id,
  CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload_json
FROM carelink_snapshots
ORDER BY fetched_at DESC
LIMIT 100

spec.title: CGM range distribution
spec.description: Percentage of valid readings in standard retrospective CGM bands: <3.0, 3.0–3.8, 3.9–10.0, 10.1–13.9 and >=13.9 mmol/L.

spec.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
 SELECT TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE) sg FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))), bands AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN sg<54 THEN '1 Very low (<3.0)' WHEN sg<70 THEN '2 Low (3.0–3.8)'
 WHEN sg<=180 THEN '3 In range (3.9–10.0)' WHEN sg<250 THEN '4 High (10.1–13.8)'
 ELSE '5 Very high (>=13.9)' END band FROM x)
SELECT band, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),1) AS percent, COUNT(*) readings
FROM bands GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

spec.title: CGM retrospective metrics
spec.description: Standard descriptive CGM calculations over the selected period. GMI requires enough representative data (typically 14 days); with this API’s ~24-hour window it is only a short-window estimate.

spec.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
 SELECT TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE) sg FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)))
SELECT ROUND(AVG(sg)/18.0182,2) AS "Mean mmol/L",
 ROUND(100*STDDEV_SAMP(sg)/NULLIF(AVG(sg),0),1) AS "CV (%)",
 ROUND(3.31+0.02392*AVG(sg),2) AS "GMI estimate (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sg BETWEEN 70 AND 180)/COUNT(*),1) AS "TIR 3.9–10 (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sg<70)/COUNT(*),1) AS "Below 3.9 (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sg>180)/COUNT(*),1) AS "Above 10 (%)",
 COUNT(*) AS readings FROM x

spec.title: Daily CGM summary
spec.description: Daily valid reading count, mean, variability, range percentages and observed span.

spec.rawSql:
WITH x AS (
 SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) t,TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE) sg
 FROM carelink_history WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)))
SELECT CAST(t AS DATE) AS day,COUNT(*) readings,ROUND(AVG(sg)/18.0182,2) "Mean mmol/L",
 ROUND(100*STDDEV_SAMP(sg)/NULLIF(AVG(sg),0),1) "CV (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sg<70)/COUNT(*),1) "Below range (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sg BETWEEN 70 AND 180)/COUNT(*),1) "In range (%)",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE sg>180)/COUNT(*),1) "Above range (%)",
 ROUND(date_diff('minute',MIN(t),MAX(t))/60.0,1) "Observed hours" FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

spec.title: Insulin and carbohydrate totals
spec.description: Totals from de-duplicated CareLink markers in the selected range. Auto-basal micro-deliveries and bolus events are separate.

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
 SELECT payload,CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) t FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='markers' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)))
SELECT
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'bolusAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='AUTO_BASAL_DELIVERY'),2) AS "Auto basal (U)",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='INSULIN'),2) AS "Bolus insulin (U)",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='INSULIN' AND (payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'activationType')='AUTOCORRECTION'),2) AS "Autocorrection (U)",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'amount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='MEAL'),1) AS "Carbohydrate (g)",
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='MEAL') AS meals FROM m

spec.title: Bolus delivery by activation type
spec.description: Completed fast insulin markers split into CareLink activation types.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
 CASE WHEN (payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'activationType')='AUTOCORRECTION'
 THEN TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE) END AS autocorrection,
 CASE WHEN (payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'activationType')<>'AUTOCORRECTION'
 THEN TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE) END AS recommended_or_other
FROM carelink_history WHERE record_type='markers' AND (payload->>'type')='INSULIN'
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Carbohydrate entries
spec.description: Meal carbohydrate entries reported by CareLink.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
 TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'amount') AS DOUBLE) AS carbohydrates
FROM carelink_history WHERE record_type='markers' AND (payload->>'type')='MEAL'
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Daily therapy summary
spec.description: Daily basal micro-delivery, bolus, autocorrection, carbohydrate and event counts from available markers.

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) t,payload FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='markers' AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)))
SELECT CAST(t AS DATE) AS day,
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'bolusAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='AUTO_BASAL_DELIVERY'),2) "Auto basal U",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='INSULIN'),2) "Bolus U",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='INSULIN' AND (payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'activationType')='AUTOCORRECTION'),2) "Autocorrection U",
 ROUND(SUM(TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'amount') AS DOUBLE)) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='MEAL'),1) "Carbs g",
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='INSULIN') boluses,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (payload->>'type')='MEAL') meals
FROM m GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

spec.title: Pump, transmitter and reservoir telemetry
spec.description: Snapshot trends accumulated while persistence is running; unlike CGM history, these values only exist from the first saved snapshot onward.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT fetched_at AS time,
 TRY_CAST((payload->'patientData'->>'pumpBatteryLevelPercent') AS DOUBLE) AS "Pump battery %",
 TRY_CAST((payload->'patientData'->>'gstBatteryLevel') AS DOUBLE) AS "Transmitter battery %",
 TRY_CAST((payload->'patientData'->>'reservoirRemainingUnits') AS DOUBLE) AS "Reservoir U",
 TRY_CAST((payload->'patientData'->>'sensorDurationHours') AS DOUBLE) AS "Sensor age h"
FROM carelink_snapshots WHERE $__timeFilter(fetched_at) ORDER BY time

spec.title: Latest system health
spec.description: Connectivity, sensor, pump, calibration and algorithm state from the latest complete response.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT fetched_at "Fetched",
 payload->'patientData'->>'systemStatusMessage' "System",
 payload->'patientData'->>'sensorState' "Sensor",
 payload->'patientData'->>'pumpCommunicationState' "Pump communicating",
 payload->'patientData'->>'gstCommunicationState' "Transmitter communicating",
 payload->'patientData'->>'conduitMedicalDeviceInRange' "Pump in range",
 payload->'patientData'->>'conduitSensorInRange' "Sensor in range",
 payload->'patientData'->>'calibStatus' "Calibration",
 payload->'patientData'->'therapyAlgorithmState'->>'autoModeReadinessState' "Auto-mode readiness",
 payload->'patientData'->'therapyAlgorithmState'->>'plgmLgsState' "Low-glucose suspend"
FROM carelink_snapshots ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1

spec.title: Data availability and freshness
spec.description: Observed CGM coverage. Expected readings assumes a nominal five-minute cadence. Snapshot freshness compares CareLink source update time with collection time.

spec.rawSql:
WITH x AS (SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) t FROM carelink_history
 WHERE record_type='sgs' AND TRY_CAST((payload->>'sg') AS DOUBLE)>0
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP))), s AS (
 SELECT fetched_at,source_updated_at_ms FROM carelink_snapshots ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT MIN(t) "First SG",MAX(t) "Last SG",COUNT(*) "Valid readings",
 ROUND(date_diff('minute',MIN(t),MAX(t))/5.0+1,0) "Expected at 5 min",
 ROUND(100*COUNT(*)/NULLIF(date_diff('minute',MIN(t),MAX(t))/5.0+1,0),1) "Coverage (%)",
 ROUND(date_diff('second',MAX(t),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)/60.0,1) "Latest SG age (min)",
 (SELECT ROUND((epoch(fetched_at)-source_updated_at_ms/1000.0)/60.0,1) FROM s) "Collection lag (min)" FROM x

spec.title: Insulin and meal event detail
spec.description: Detailed therapy event fields extracted from the original marker JSON.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,payload->>'type' AS event,
 payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'activationType' activation,
 TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'deliveredFastAmount') AS DOUBLE) "Insulin U",
 TRY_CAST((payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'amount') AS DOUBLE) "Carbs g",
 payload->'data'->'dataValues'->>'completed' completed,CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload_json
FROM carelink_history WHERE record_type='markers' AND (payload->>'type') IN ('INSULIN','MEAL')
 AND $__timeFilter(CAST(event_time AS TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 500
